privacy.free_text_warning: Do not enter names, email addresses, phone numbers, exact employer names or other identifying information.
privacy.server_metadata_policy: retain only security metadata strictly necessary for abuse prevention, logically separated from the analytical dataset and deleted on the shortest documented schedule
privacy.respondent_id: server-generated cryptographically random opaque ID with no identity lookup table
privacy.organisation_id: server-generated cryptographically random opaque ID with no identity lookup table
privacy.followup_contacts: separate purpose, separate dataset, separate privacy notice; never join to analytical response
launch_gate: controller identity and GDPR contact frozen from current EUCONS legal notice

integrity.rate_limit: required but must not create persistent analytical identifiers
integrity.duplicate_policy: do not silently deduplicate people; assign one response ID per accepted submission and detect exact payload replay separately
integrity.analysis_copy: derived from immutable raw export; transformations logged
integrity.percentage_rule: every reported percentage must retain numerator, denominator and valid-response rule

deployment_observation.constraint: GitHub Pages cannot persist survey POST data; a separately secured first-party API/storage runtime is required before collection can be enabled.
deployment_observation.do_not_reuse: commercial /api/leads pipeline because analytical responses must remain separate from CRM/marketing
